description: Submit a publicly reachable audio or video URL for copyright screening. Returns immediately with a report_id and QUEUED status; the finished result is available from get_screening. Starting a screening is a paid call on the signed-in WIA account (WIA MCP Pro plan or credits).

url.description: Publicly reachable https URL of the audio or video file
